profile.name: Bijaya Acharya
profile.headline: ML engineer · LLM efficiency, agents & RAG · MSc Data Analytics
profile.summary: I build LLM systems end to end: compressing models with post-training quantization, training and fine-tuning language and vision-language models, and shipping agents and RAG services with tests and evaluations. MSc Data Analytics student at the University of Hildesheim, researching 2-bit LLM quantization.
profile.availability: Open to working-student and HiWi roles · 20 h/week · remote in Germany, or Hildesheim / Hannover / Braunschweig
profile.workAuthorization: Residence permit (§16b) valid until Oct 2028 · full-time during semester breaks

experience.organization: NAAMII · Nepal Applied Mathematics and Informatics Institute for Research
details: Built and evaluated ML workflows for imbalanced clinical cancer datasets, supporting interpretation of model outputs.
Contributed analysis, research support, and documentation to an IEEE publication.
Developed and deployed Python-based ML and data solutions for small-business use cases.
Worked across teams on analytics, automation, and practical delivery requirements.

publication.title: ScaleFit: 2-bit post-training quantization of LLMs on a single consumer GPU
publication.venue: Student Research Project · University of Hildesheim
publication.contribution: Llama-3.1-8B at 2 bits: WikiText-2 perplexity 9.59 with 5.7 GiB peak GPU memory. Code on request.

publication.title: Machine Learning Models Predicting Radiation Pneumonitis Based on a Multi-Omics and Multi-Regional Approach in Patients with Lung Cancer Treated on the NRG/RTOG 0617 Clinical Trial
publication.contribution: Contributed clinical ML analysis, research support and documentation.

projects.title: quant-paper-rag
projects.description: RAG over LLM-quantization papers: hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval, Claude answering through a search tool, and page-level citations checked against what was retrieved. Includes a labelled retrieval eval (recall@5 0.90).

projects.title: MRAgent
projects.description: Open-source terminal AI coding agent: file, shell, search, git and browser tools across 7 LLM providers, with context compaction, cost tracking, chat history and a task scheduler. Published on PyPI.

projects.title: SketchAWQ
projects.description: 3/4-bit post-training quantization adding a low-rank Hessian sketch to AWQ-style scale search, with packed INT3/INT4 export. Lower INT3 perplexity than GPTQ on Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B and Mistral-7B; 2.6× faster to quantize.

projects.title: NovaMind 256M
projects.description: Designed and trained a ~256M-parameter conversational transformer from scratch, including pretraining, instruction tuning, and H100-based training.

projects.title: SilentWitness
projects.description: Offline, privacy-preserving assistant built on Gemma 4 that helps document abuse without an internet connection. Built for the Kaggle Gemma 4 Good Hackathon (Safety & Trust track).

projects.title: Radiology VLM
projects.description: Fine-tuned Florence-2 with LoRA on VQA-RAD for image-grounded radiology question answering; packaged local Gradio and serverless API interfaces.

projects.title: Pneumonia Detection API
projects.description: Fine-tuned a ViT model for chest X-ray classification and served predictions through a serverless FastAPI endpoint on Modal.

projects.title: Analytics Data Platform
projects.description: Built a Bronze / Silver / Gold analytics pipeline for reporting using SQL and data transformation workflows, with dashboard outputs.

projects.title: Customer Churn ML
projects.description: DuckDB ingestion, preprocessing, model comparison, and a Flask prediction service for customer churn; documented ROC-AUC of 0.8717.
